findings.claim: The change modifies root dependencies without including the corresponding pnpm-lock.yaml update, so the workflow's frozen installs will fail.
findings.evidence: package.json adds and changes many devDependencies and pnpm overrides in the hunk starting at `"devDependencies"`, while the diff contains no pnpm-lock.yaml hunk; `.github/workflows/publish.yml` runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in version-pr, rehearse, and stage jobs, and the task acceptance criteria require running relevant pnpm gates from a clean state.
findings.suggested_fix: Commit the generated pnpm-lock.yaml changes produced by `pnpm install --lockfile-only` or revert the package.json dependency changes.
